newsitem.title: USA: Pa. 833 MW Beaver Valley 2 nuclear unit restarts.
newsitem.headline: Pa. 833 MW Beaver Valley 2 nuclear unit restarts.

text.p: The 833 megawatt (MW) Beaver Valley 2 nuclear generating unit restarted this past weekend following an extended refueling and repair outage, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission said Monday.
In its daily status report, NRC said the Shippingport, Pa., unit was operating at 15 percent power while holding for turbine trip checks. Its turbine was not yet on line.
Beaver Valley unit 2 was originally shut August 30 for refueling, but its early December restart was pushed back for repairs of its vessel head vent system.
The neighboring Beaver Valley 1, rated at 810 MW, was operating at full output, NRC said.
DQE, Inc., Duquesne's parent company, holds 13.7 percent stake in Beaver Valley 2, Ohio Edison 41.9 percent and Centerior Energy 44.4 percent.
DQE owns 47.5 percent of Beaver Valley 1. The remaining 52.5 percent is owned by Ohio Edison.
